        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>notifyIntent</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>readFinalMpon</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>dismountMpon</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>mergeDismount</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>mountNew</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>readMeter</bpmn:flowNodeRef>

        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>tellGo</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>

        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>decideSelf</bpmn:flowNodeRef>

        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>readFinalOwn</bpmn:flowNodeRef>

        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>notifyNoSelf</bpmn:flowNodeRef>

        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>end</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
    </bpmn:laneSet>
    <bpmn:startEvent id="start" name="Equipment change intention arises" />
    <bpmn:task id="notifyIntent" name="Notify the MPOO about equipment change intentions" />
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="decideSelf" name="MPOO self-dismounts?" />
    <bpmn:task id="announceSelf" name="Announce self dismounting to the MPON" />
    <bpmn:task id="readFinalOwn" name="Perform the final reading" />
    <bpmn:task id="dismountOwn" name="Dismount the old equipment" />
    <bpmn:task id="notifyNoSelf" name="Notify the MPON about no self-dismounting" />
    <bpmn:task id="readFinalMpon" name="Perform the final reading" />
    <bpmn:task id="dismountMpon" name="Dismount the old equipment" />
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="mergeDismount" />
    <bpmn:task id="mountNew" name="Mount the new device" />
    <bpmn:task id="readMeter" name="Read the meter count from the installed meter" />
    <bpmn:task id="sendFinal" name="Send the values of the final reading to the GO" />
    <bpmn:task id="tellGo" name="Tell the GO about the device changes, the master data and the meter count at installation" />
    <bpmn:task id="notifyMsp" name="Notify the MSP about the device changes, the master data, the meter count at dismounting and the meter count at installation" />
    <bpmn:endEvent id="end" name="Equipment change completed" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f1" sourceRef="start" targetRef="notifyIntent" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f2" sourceRef="notifyIntent" targetRef="decideSelf" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f3" name="yes" sourceRef="decideSelf" targetRef="announceSelf" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f4" name="no" sourceRef="decideSelf" targetRef="notifyNoSelf" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f5" sourceRef="announceSelf" targetRef="readFinalOwn" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f6" sourceRef="readFinalOwn" targetRef="dismountOwn" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f7" sourceRef="dismountOwn" targetRef="mergeDismount" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f8" sourceRef="notifyNoSelf" targetRef="readFinalMpon" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f9" sourceRef="readFinalMpon" targetRef="dismountMpon" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f10" sourceRef="dismountMpon" targetRef="mergeDismount" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f11" sourceRef="mergeDismount" targetRef="mountNew" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f12" sourceRef="mountNew" targetRef="readMeter" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f13" sourceRef="readMeter" targetRef="sendFinal" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f14" sourceRef="sendFinal" targetRef="tellGo" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f15" sourceRef="tellGo" targetRef="notifyMsp" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f16" sourceRef="notifyMsp" targetRef="end" />
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
